prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” — the right roofing company for you depends on your location in Dallas, roof type, budget, whether it’s an insurance job, and the level of warranty/service you want. I can find top-rated local roofers for your exact ZIP, or you can use the guidance below to pick the best contractor near you.

How to pick the best roofer for a replacement
- Get 3 written estimates so you can compare scope, materials, and price.
- Verify insurance and bonding: contractor should carry general liability and workers’ comp (or provide proof subcontractors are covered).
- Check credentials: manufacturer certifications (GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning, etc.) mean extended warranties and trained installers.
- Look up reviews and complaints: Google Reviews, BBB, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor, and recent customer references.
- Ask about permits and inspections: a good roofer pulls permits and coordinates inspections.
- Warranty clarity: get both the manufacturer shingle warranty and a written workmanship warranty from the contractor (length and coverage).
- Experience with insurance claims: if you’re filing a homeowner’s claim, choose a roofer experienced with adjusters and claims paperwork.
- Written contract: include start/end dates, materials (brand/model/color), cleanup plan, payment schedule, and lien releases for subcontractors.

Questions to ask a roofer
- How long have you been in business in Dallas?
- Are you licensed/registered for roofing in Texas and insured? Can I see certificates?
- Are you a certified installer for the shingle/manufacturer I want?
- Can you provide 3 recent local references and photos of past jobs?
- Who will supervise the job, and who is responsible for cleanup?
- What are the warranty details (manufacturer + workmanship) in writing?
- Do you pull permits and arrange inspections?
- What is the payment schedule?

Red flags
- Contractor wants full payment up front.
- No written contract or unwillingness to provide references.
- No proof of insurance or refuses to list insurance company.
- High-pressure sales tactics or door-to-door storm-chasers without local references.

If you want, I can:
- Look up highly rated roofers in your exact Dallas ZIP (I’ll provide 4–6 vetted options with links and notes), or
- Draft an email/message you can send to several contractors to request bids and references.

Which would you like — I can find top-rated companies near you if you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial.
